# FitAI — Fitness AI Mini App

> FitAI is an AI-powered personal fitness coach and workout planner that lives inside a Telegram Mini App. It uses the DeepSeek LLM (text + vision) to coach users, generate personalized workout plans, analyze body photos, and adapt plans over time. The UI is fully bilingual (English and Arabic with RTL).

## What FitAI does

- Onboarding questionnaire: goal, level, experience, weekly training days, equipment, body stats, injuries and diet.
- AI Coach chat: DeepSeek-powered answers grounded in the user's profile, saved plans, exercise logs and progress stats. Points are charged per query (5 pts) and only after a successful answer.
- Workout plan generation: structured weekly plans (push/pull/legs/core/cardio) built from the user's goal and level, with the user choosing a start and end date for a program of up to 8 weeks (two months) per generation; each plan ships with a week-by-week progress chart.
- Plan editing with approval: the coach proposes structured edits (replace/update/add/remove exercises, change sets and reps); the user approves before anything is applied.
- Exercise tracking: tick every exercise; day/week/month/all-time rollups plus plan counts, exercises-done totals and a per-week progress chart are persisted and fed back to the coach.
- Body photo analysis: users upload photos; a DeepSeek vision model analyzes posture/form against the profile and suggests plan corrections.
- Points economy: 250 free welcome points; AI coach answers cost 50 pts, workout plans cost 250 pts (the welcome bonus covers the first plan), plan-edit proposals cost 50 pts; Telegram Stars top-ups (500 pts / 50 ⭐ and 1000 pts / 100 ⭐) with pre-checkout validation and refund support.
- Localization: English and Arabic dictionaries, RTL layout for Arabic, localized exercise names and instructions.
- Marketing Engine (autonomous): cron pipeline that drops content 3×/week (Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday, Riyadh) — all marketing copy in Arabic. 18:00 generate (Llama-3 Arabic captions, SD3-medium image, fal.ai Kling workflow video whose Arabic prompt is a rotating FitAI pain→value marketing angle, not a gym promo), 19:00 distribute through Composio (API v3) to X/Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn plus a Telegram Bot API broadcast to all users (25 msg/sec batching), 24:00 daily storage cleanup (assets deleted 24h after completion). Dormant until MARKETING_ENABLED=true; full prompts documented in convex/marketing/PROMPTS.md.

## Technology

- Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4 frontend hosted on Vercel.
- Convex backend (database, mutations, queries, actions) for users, profiles, plans, exercise logs, coach messages, payments and feature requests.
- DeepSeek API: deepseek-v4-flash (text) and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp (vision, base64 image input).
- Telegram Mini Apps SDK: initData HMAC auth, Telegram Stars invoices, webhooks.
- Exercise data: vendored curated subset of free-exercise-db (Unlicense), images served via jsDelivr CDN.
